083: 1300–1347. Bird's-eye view almost straight down on a market unloading square in spring midday. A timber ox-cart JUST arriving from top edge occupies upper left, its shadow diagonal. Centre is a conspicuously EMPTY rectangular unloading patch roped off, opposite lower right a line of idle empty market stalls. Three very small porters seen from above wait separately on corners, no large foreground people, no back-facing observer frame. Timber arrival and unused market space both plainly readable. Entire composition is a spatial plan observed overhead, rather than a pair watching into depth.
086: 1300–1347. Unpaid freight: a stern carrier kneels ALONE high atop a loaded stationary wooden cart, full body in side profile, tightening a rope across a woman's distinctive tied red wool bundle so she cannot take it. Owner is a tiny full figure at lower right reaching one arm upward and showing an empty coin purse, separated vertically not face to face. Cart seen entirely side-on in silhouette against plain light plaster yard wall, wheels, rope and withheld bundle dominate. No faces opposing over a table, no observer framing. Late afternoon in summer.
088: 1348–1381. High steep overhead view of a malt drying floor in an open barn, split into two long textured bands: germinating dark barley spread thin with wooden malt rake left, pale wheat still bagged beside flour and bread on right. A large brown ale jug sits at left edge, a bread basket at right edge. Two workers reduced to SMALL separate kneeling full figures at opposite distant corners, no large bust portraits, no counter or bowls between facing people. One central empty narrow path cleanly separates brewing grain and milling grain. Soft autumn daylight, strong visible grain distinction.
090: 1348–1381. A SMALL SHOP REPAIR scene viewed straight down from high open loft. Broken old shutter removed from doorway lies FLAT on the workshop floor, split lengthwise with hinges attached; a straight new timber board lies diagonally alongside it. One elderly female carpenter stands above the objects and measures the replacement with a wooden rule without markings. The floor, shutter, new wood and scattered plain wedges fill image, only her small full figure at top. No right-hand closed door approached by a person, no frontal street. Winter daylight.
